title: COUNT DISTINCT
flavorText: COUNT(DISTINCT col) counts unique values only. COUNT(*) counts all rows — two very different results.
narrative: How many distinct products were sold in each month? One product sold 5 times still counts as 1 distinct product.
schemaSql: CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, month TEXT NOT NULL, product TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, amount REAL NOT NULL);
seedSql: INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1,'Jan','Datapad',3,899.97),(2,'Jan','Power Cell',10,199.90),(3,'Feb','Datapad',5,1499.95),(4,'Feb','Logic Board',2,179.98),(5,'Mar','Optic Lens',1,149.99),(6,'Mar','Servo Motor',4,220.00),(7,'Mar','Datapad',2,599.98),(8,'Apr','Power Cell',20,399.80),(9,'Apr','Logic Board',5,449.95),(10,'Apr','Steel Cable',50,425.00);
task: Count the number of distinct products sold each month. Order by month alphabetically.

hints.text: COUNT(DISTINCT product) counts unique product names per group, not total rows.
SELECT month, COUNT(DISTINCT product) AS distinct_products FROM sales GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
SELECT month, COUNT(DISTINCT product) AS distinct_products FROM sales GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
